title: render_sets/<name>.json
description: Photoreal render sets for tools/render_batch.py (local) and tools/render_modal.py --batch (cloud).

lighting.description: Comma-separated presets (day, night, evening, standard) or room.json scene names; default standard.

meterLayout.description: Meter the auto exposure on this layout (e.g. today's) so a proposal renders at the same exposure.
